title: Gary Municipal Building, 401 Broadway, Gary, Lake County, IN
notes: Significance: The current City Hall structure was erected in 1927 as an integral element of the Gateway Plan.  The Gateway Plan, proposed by the Gary Commerce Club in 1924, was to be designed in such a manner as to create a balanced integration of landscaping and structures providing an aesthetically pleasing "front door" to the city.  The Gateway Plan was designed to consist of a park, a court building, and the City Hall at a cost of three million dollars.
